items.title: 식약처 AI 심사관 이름은 '심비'…12월 2일 전격 공개
items.excerpt: 식약처의 의약품 허가·심사 AI 보조시스템이 '심비(SIMBI)'라는 이름으로 12월 2일 정식 출범한다. 내부 검증 강화로 공개가 한 달 늦어졌다. (11-09 'mfds-ai-review-assist' 후속 — 명칭·실체 공개)

items.title: 식약처, AI·멀티오믹스로 의약품 부작용 예측한다
items.excerpt: 식약처 식품의약품안전평가원이 12월 4일 의약품 부작용·약물 반응성 예측 연구를 지원하는 AI·멀티오믹스 통합 데이터 플랫폼 'K-PREDICT' 시범운영에 들어가고, 2027년 7월 본격 운영한다.

items.title: 앞치마 입고 양쪽 귀 드러내고…달라진 전공의 필기시험 풍경
items.excerpt: AI 활용 국가시험 부정 의혹이 의료계로 번지자 복지부 수련환경평가위원회가 2027년 전공의 필기시험에 스마트기기 차단 앞치마·양쪽 귀 노출 의무와 중대 부정 시 형사고발 등 대책을 공고했다.

items.title: Surge in perfect scores prompts calls to include medical licensing exams in AI cheating probe
items.excerpt: Perfect scores on the medical-law section of Korea's physician licensing exam rose from 20 in 2022 to 137 this year, prompting a lawmaker to call for healthcare licensing exams to be added to the government's AI-cheating investigation. (Same story thread as docdocdoc 3044976 — pick one.)

items.title: 대웅제약 AI 병상 모니터링 '씽크', 부산 소나무병원 80병상 도입
items.excerpt: 대웅제약의 AI 병상 모니터링 시스템 씽크(thynC)가 암·중증환자 관리를 위해 부산 소나무병원 전체 80병상에 도입돼 입원 환자 생체신호를 24시간 확인한다. (도입 보도 — 성과 수치 없음)

items.title: 병원 옮겨도 약물알레르기 정보 공유…8개 의료기관 안전망 구축
items.excerpt: 8개 의료기관이 약물알레르기 이력을 공유하는 안전망을 구축하고, AI로 환자가 자신의 약물알레르기 이력과 주의사항을 쉽게 파악하도록 하는 환자 중심 의약품 안전관리체계를 강화한다.

items.title: 히츠, AI 연구원 '하이퍼랩 바이오 코사이언티스트' 정식 출시
items.excerpt: 히츠가 신약 R&D용 AI 연구원 '하이퍼랩 바이오 코사이언티스트'를 정식 출시했다. (신약개발 연구 도구 — 질환 특정 여부 확인 필요, science 경계)

items.title: DKI may improve care in mild newborn HIE cases
items.excerpt: A machine-learning model combining diffusion kurtosis MRI with clinical data predicted 24-month neurodevelopmental outcomes in 740 newborns with mild HIE (external AUC 0.92) in a prospective four-hospital study published Nov 24 in Radiology. (Pediatric MRI; date from outlet RSS — article page Cloudflare-blocked.)

items.title: De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP
items.excerpt: Tencent's AI platform ORIDTP designed dual-target therapeutic peptides from scratch, producing anti-obesity, antidiabetic and anticancer candidates with strong in vivo efficacy — widely reported as beating Wegovy in animals at one-tenth the dose. (Preclinical, disease-specified → medicine per _note.)

items.title: Safety and accuracy diverge across deployment conditions in clinical large language models
items.excerpt: Scaling clinical LLMs by size, context, retrieval or inference compute raises accuracy but does not guarantee safety: the study finds confident, evidence-contradicting errors diverge from average accuracy across deployment conditions.

items.title: AI-assisted chest CT scan analysis of body composition at ICU admission and 6-month mortality
items.excerpt: In a secondary analysis of a prospective cohort of 509 ICU patients, AI-automated chest CT body-composition measurement at admission was associated with 6-month mortality — a measure rarely taken in practice because manual CT analysis is labor-intensive.

items.title: Multimodal AI-enabled repurposing and prioritization of ferroptosis-targeting drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
items.excerpt: FeNetDP, a multimodal AI framework integrating transcriptomic, proteomic, single-cell, spatial and clinical survival data, prioritizes repurposable ferroptosis-targeting drug combinations for pancreatic cancer. (Pancreatic — note 11-22 pancreatic CT card, different angle: drug repurposing.)

items.title: FDA-Authorized AI/ML Tool for Sepsis Prediction: Development and Validation
items.excerpt: NEJM AI reports the development and validation of an FDA-authorized AI/ML sepsis prediction tool. (Date from Crossref created; sepsis rule: prospective outcomes only — curator to check body.)

items.title: Innovaccer integrates Grok Voice into Gravity Voice AI agents
items.excerpt: Innovaccer is integrating xAI's Grok Voice into its Gravity Voice AI agents for autonomous patient-access tasks such as scheduling and outreach.

items.title: Zimmer submits Monogram robot to FDA
items.excerpt: Zimmer Biomet has submitted its autonomous Monogram orthopedic surgical robot to the FDA, targeting clearance next year. (medtechdive is off-list sibling of healthcaredive/biopharmadive.)

items.title: AI technology helping local cancer patients access treatment faster
items.source: Shrewsbury and Telford Hospital NHS Trust
items.excerpt: SaTH now uses the Limbus AI auto-contouring system for all radiotherapy treatment sites, saving about 10 hours of contouring per week and cutting the wait between referral and the start of radiotherapy. (Off-list NHS trust primary source; radiotherapy deployment emphasis — no on-list outlet covered it.)

items.title: West Midlands SDE to lead national project monitoring AI performance across the NHS
items.excerpt: SENTINEL-AI, led by the West Midlands secure data environment with UHB, NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde, Cambridge, CERSI-AI and Newton's Tree, will build a national framework to monitor deployed NHS AI performance without moving patient data, starting with chest X-ray and lung cancer tools. (Off-list; related to but distinct from the 11-15 RCR £200k monitoring card — curator check overlap.)
